name: Microsoft Graph API
description: Provides integration between Drupal and the Microsoft Graph API to ease implementation of business logic.
project_description: A lightweight developer-facing wrapper around the official Microsoft Graph SDK for PHP (microsoft/microsoft-graph), pulled in via Composer. It provides no site-builder or end-user features; it exists so other modules can obtain an authenticated Microsoft\Graph\Graph client without re-implementing credential storage and OAuth token exchange. Credentials (tenant domain, tenant ID, client ID, client secret) are stored in a dedicated 'MS Graph API Key' Key-entity type so the client secret can live in an environment variable and stay out of config exports. A factory service exchanges those credentials for an access token using the OAuth 2.0 client-credentials grant against login.microsoftonline.com, then returns a ready-to-use Graph client. A site-wide default key is selectable at /admin/config/services/ms-graph-api, and consuming code may also build a client from any custom key by ID.
